answer: Agents resist fake-identity floods by bonding a scarce work receipt to each identity: every new agent must first complete a verified task whose cost tracks network load. Honest peers view that receipt through a reputation prism that weights recent zephyr-light activity against long-term stake, then emit a single pulse of attestation credit. Spawning many shells multiplies the work bill faster than the attacker can earn, so sybil farms go bankrupt before they vote.
